claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Amisulpride is a hydrophilic dopamine D2/D3 antagonist that is not expected to kill cells at 2.5 uM; any weak, non-selective antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect a cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress off-target rather than DRD2 antagonism.
